title: Avoiding duplicated caches: Store only UI selection or preferences in Zustand; keep authoritative remote records in a server/query cache and derive the chosen record by ID.
description: A complete Zustand 5 state-boundaries lesson using actual vanilla stores, targeted subscriptions and safe client state ownership, including a red starter and offline regression tests.
objectives: Store only UI selection or preferences in Zustand; keep authoritative remote records in a server/query cache and derive the chosen record by ID.
Repair the zustand-dont-cache-records intentionally broken Zustand 5 starter.
Explain what belongs in local, URL or authoritative remote data state.
rubric: I can explain the state ownership principle for avoiding duplicated caches.
I can repair the 09.04.07 defect using actual Zustand 5 APIs.
I can identify persistence, privacy and hydration risks needing integration tests.
